about: MobileNetV3-Large (ImageNet-pretrained) fine-tuned on TrashNet + TACO crops + Stable-Diffusion-generated organic/other images; classifier-head weights int8, 13 MB. About 64% accurate on 150 held-out real-world photos (not 91% as on TrashNet studio photos); answers 'not sure' below 60% confidence. Indicative only.
